dedupe_keys.name: epluspar energyplus sensitivity and bayesian calibration

description: epluspar is an R package developed by Jia and Chong for sensitivity analysis and Bayesian calibration of EnergyPlus models. Users define input and output variables, set parameter ranges, generate model variants, run simulations in parallel and collect results. Its package metadata names the Morris method for sensitivity analysis and Stan for Bayesian calibration. Field measurements can be supplied for calibration, while EnergyPlus report dictionaries define compatible variables. Public development source is free under MIT, as stated in the DESCRIPTION file and accompanying licence notice. The README says the package is not on CRAN. Coverage is a user-supplied building and measurement period; detail depends on the model and reporting interval. Caveats include matching input and output reporting frequencies, preventing a variable from serving both roles and managing the R, Stan and EnergyPlus dependencies. The tool helps calibrate building demand models and compare parameter influence. It builds on eplusr and the catalogue's EnergyPlus engine (model-energyplus), not supplying an independently validated building model.
